newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers rise on the East Coast.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers rise on the East Coast.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mostly stable late this week, though prices in Houston appeared to be retreating from recent highs, traders said.
In Houston, spot 380 CST was pegged between $97 and $98 a tonne, up from a week ago but below levels earlier in the week, while 180 CST was pegged at 100 to 101.

Prices in New York Harbor were pegged about on par with Houston, a sign East Coast action has been quite subdued in recent sessions, traders said. The 180 CST barrels were at about $102 a tonne, while 380 CST was between $96 and $97 a tonne. Prices were largely unchanged.
